lines.en: Marta, you look like you haven’t slept. What is going on with the job offer from Austin?
lines.pt: Marta, você parece que não dormiu. O que está acontecendo com a oferta de emprego de Austin?

lines.en: I turned down the offer last month. Now I wish I had accepted it, but I also feel relieved.
lines.pt: Eu recusei a oferta no mês passado. Agora queria ter aceitado, mas também me sinto aliviado.

lines.en: Mixed feelings, then? If you had accepted, you would have left your family and friends here.
lines.pt: Sentimentos misturados, então? Se você tivesse aceitado, teria deixado sua família e seus amigos aqui.

lines.en: True. But if only I had taken the risk, I might have learned so much more.
lines.pt: Verdade. Mas se ao menos eu tivesse arriscado, talvez tivesse aprendido muito mais.

lines.en: You shouldn’t have decided in a hurry, though. I wish you had asked me for advice first.
lines.pt: Você não devia ter decidido com pressa, porém. Eu queria que você tivesse me pedido conselho antes.

lines.en: I should have called you. I wish I could go back and think about it more calmly.
lines.pt: Eu devia ter ligado para você. Queria poder voltar e pensar com mais calma.

lines.en: Well, they are still hiring. If you called them tomorrow, they might give you a second chance.
lines.pt: Bem, eles ainda estão contratando. Se você ligasse amanhã, talvez dessem uma segunda chance.

lines.en: Do you really think so? I wish I knew what to say after refusing so quickly.
lines.pt: Você acha mesmo? Queria saber o que dizer depois de recusar tão rápido.

lines.en: Be honest. If I were you, I would explain that you needed time and that you changed your mind.
lines.pt: Seja sincero. Se eu fosse você, explicaria que precisou de tempo e que mudou de ideia.

lines.en: That sounds good. I wish I had your confidence. You would have taken the job immediately, wouldn’t you?
lines.pt: Parece bom. Queria ter a sua confiança. Você teria aceitado o emprego na hora, não é?

lines.en: Probably not. I would have hesitated too. We all have regrets, and the best thing is to learn from them.
lines.pt: Provavelmente não. Eu também teria hesitado. Todos temos arrependimentos, e o melhor é aprender com eles.

facts.big: I wish I had accepted it
facts.label: Revisão: if, wish, should have
facts.sub: Use wish + had, should have + particípio e if + would have para falar do passado. Use If I were you, I would… para dar conselho.

facts.label: eu queria ter + particípio
facts.sub: Use wish + had + particípio para lamentar o passado: I wish I had accepted it. Não use would have depois de wish.

facts.label: você devia ter + particípio
facts.sub: Use should have + particípio para criticar uma decisão passada: You shouldn’t have decided in a hurry. I should have called you.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I wish I had accepted means I did not accept.
We say “I should have took the job.”
If I were you, I would call them is a second conditional.
items.why: Yes, it is advice about now.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I wish I had accepted means I did not accept. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I should have took the job.” → Falso (We say should have taken.)
If I were you, I would call them is a second conditional. → Verdadeiro (Yes, it is advice about now.)

pages.title: Mixed feelings in Houston · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cloudy Thursday morning in Houston. Noah arrives at the café with dark circles under his eyes. Kai is already at their usual table by the window. He has ordered two black coffees. Noah has not stopped thinking about a job in Austin. Kai puts his phone away and waits for him to talk.

“Noah, you look like you haven’t slept. What is going on with the job offer from Austin?” says Kai. “I turned down the offer last month. Now I wish I had accepted it, but I also feel relieved.” says Noah. “Mixed feelings, then? If you had accepted, you would have left your family and friends here.” says Kai.
